Messages.Author: 2wayspeaker
Messages.Body:
Deck Name: Petaniqua World Tour
Author: 2wayspeaker
Description:
Free Werewolves

Ideal position: 4th

T1 (30)
Make shure you get Zillah's Valley
Influence a small cap and put one on Petaniqua. -4

T2 (17)
Play Zillah's Valley and Influence 4 on Petaniqua. -9
Cycle for Charisma or Powerbase: Tshwane.

T3 (15)
Play Charisma or Powerbase: Tshwane
Use Mask of a Thousand Faces to recruit a Tunnel Runner under +2/3 Stealth. -2
Cycle for the missing master.

T4 (14)
Play Charisma or Powerbase:Tshwane.
Tunnel Runners are now 1 pool.
Use Mask of a Thousand Faces to recruit a Tunnel Runner under +2/3 Stealth.

T5 onward
Recover with Theft & Vagabond.
Deal with the devil to get rid of the choke.
Play all three events for optimal effect.

==================================================

Is this competitive, does it stand a chance?

Messages.Body:
> 2wayspeaker wrote:
> Because getting out advanced with certainty means either such an unbalanced crypt (5, 4, 3) it can get pentexed and I will never get a second vampire.
>
> Also it was late and I made a mistake. Tunnel runners will cost 1.

D you mean advanced, or merged?

Advanced version is mandatory because you won't be able to recruit the Tunnel Runners with her otherwise.

Merging her is not necessary, even though playing 5 Petaniqua ADV + 1 Petanique base gives you a chance to do so without jeopardizing your game.

Keep in mind that Petanique is infernal, meaning using her each turn roughly "costs" 1 pool.

Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
> 2wayspeaker wrote:
> Do you think there's a concept to be made with
> - Information Highway
> - Mapatano Utanda
> - Villein
> - Golconda: inner peace
> - Soul Gem of Etrius
> - Redeem the lost soul
>
Golconda removes the vampire from the game, they're not in your ash heap. Soul Gem only triggers if they burn, so it doesn't trigger off Golconda. Redeem the Lost Soul requires the target to be in the ash heap, so not removed from game.

The first 4 cards work as a great way to make a lot of pool, but then you end up with no vampires in play and a pile of pool. Now you need a way to oust your prey.
